run_speed_estimation: run vehicle speed estimation using YOLO-NAS and supervision with configurable confidence and IOU thresholds
create_view_transformer: create a ViewTransformer instance that applies perspective transform from source to target coordinate space
transform_coordinates: transform detection anchor coordinates from camera view to a bird's-eye view coordinate system
build_byte_track_tracker: build a ByteTrack tracker with frame rate and confidence threshold for vehicle tracking across video frames
annotate_video_frame: annotate video frames with bounding boxes, labels, and motion traces for detected vehicles
